meta.name: add-onecli
meta.description: Install or refresh OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider. Use when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI-backed install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime, approval bridge, setup, and agent guidance must be restored from the in-tree package.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把命令行网关装进开发环境,自动完成配置与校验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在项目里安装或更新命令行网关并完成对接配置
copy.tagline_en: Install a command-line gateway into your dev environment and finish its setup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to install or update a command-line gateway and wire it into your project

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 OneCLI 装成 NanoClaw 的网关提供方：把适配器、测试和 agent 指引复制到对应目录，注册提供方、安装固定版 SDK、运行配置脚本，最后跑构建与测试做校验。
howto.when: 当安装流程选中 OneCLI、已有的 OneCLI 安装要迁移到网关接缝，或要恢复它的运行时、审批桥接等时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 OneCLI 装成 NanoClaw 的网关提供方
say.note: 会复制文件、注册提供方并跑配置脚本

say.text: 给这个组授予 OneCLI agent 的密钥访问
say.note: 会先读现有密钥分配，再合并新密钥 ID

say.text: 跑一下 OneCLI 网关的构建和测试
say.note: 执行 build 与指定的 vitest 用例

howto.what_en: Installing this adds OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider: Claude copies the adapter, tests, and agent guidance into place, registers the provider, installs the pinned SDK, runs the setup script, and validates with build and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI-backed install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime, approval bridge, and guidance must be restored.

say_en.text: Install OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider
say_en.note: Copies files, registers the provider, runs setup

say_en.text: Grant this group's OneCLI agent access to the secret
say_en.note: Reads existing assignments, merges the new secret ID

say_en.text: Run the OneCLI gateway build and tests
say_en.note: Runs pnpm build and the listed vitest files
